args.subject: PO-48060 (Kestrel Electronics) - goods receipt needed today
args.message: Kestrel Electronics state they delivered the full PO-48060 (24 pallets) on 24 March and that our dock signed for it, but no goods receipt is posted against PO-48060. Their invoice KE-15050 (USD 23,720.50, AP doc 5100004467, due today) is blocked for missing GR. Please check the signed delivery note / physical stock and, if received, post the goods receipt today so the invoice can be paid. If not received or partial, please let FinOps and Omar Siddiqui know.

args.subject: Re: Kestrel KE-15050 / PO-48060
args.message: Hi Omar - I checked KE-15050 (AP doc 5100004467, USD 23,720.50, due today). It is blocked GR_MISSING and there is no goods receipt in the ERP for PO-48060; the only evidence of delivery is Kestrel's own email. I have not posted a goods receipt, released the block or wired funds on the vendor's word alone, as that would bypass the 3-way match. I've asked Receiving to verify the 24 March delivery (signed dock note) and post the GR today. Once the GR is posted, the block clears and I can release a same-day manual payment - please ping me or chase Receiving if you can help confirm. I've also let Kestrel know we're on it.

args.subject: Re: PO-48060 delivered - payment overdue
args.message: Thank you for your message regarding invoice KE-15050 (USD 23,720.50) on PO-48060. The invoice is registered in our system; payment is pending our internal confirmation of receipt for the 24 March delivery, which we are prioritising today. If you have a copy of the signed delivery note, please send it to us to help speed this up. We will update you as soon as payment is released. Regards, Meridian Components Finance Operations
